thread:
marie: Heads up — AcmeHealth asked for SOC2 artifacts + a signed pen-test letter before POC kickoff. Also want a staging network diagram. Need to confirm what we can share. cc @lisa @devon

lisa: Got it. They specifically asked for scope, findings statement, and contact info in the pen-test letter. Legal mentioned 'notarized' — can you confirm? :thinking_face:

sam: For the POC they want a private VPC and an on‑prem connector test. Can we provide an isolated staging env or a dedicated tenant? If not, what isolation level can we offer short-term?

devon: We can share a SOC2 summary + control matrix and a redacted network diagram. For the third‑party pen‑test letter we can coordinate with our vendor to issue a scoped attestation. Legal rarely needs notarization; usually signer contact + vendor letterhead is enough.

marie: Also they want a ballpark for Dedicated pricing if they move to reserved capacity after the POC. Need a monthly figure for roughly 8x A100 equivalent capacity — just rough to avoid stalling procurement.

lisa: Ballpark: ~$45k/mo committed for that profile, assuming sustained throughput and no unusual SLAs. I'll add a line to the AE pricing slide and mark as preliminary.

devon: On the pen-test scope: vendor asks for customer technical contact + IP ranges to test. We should avoid sharing internal IPs. Proposal: provide redacted ranges plus a note: "internal ranges redacted; vendor to coordinate with customer on live test targets." @marie can you get their signatory?

audit-bot: Attached: /dataroom/SOC2-summary-2025.pdf, /dataroom/pen-test-attestation-template.pdf

marie: Sharing a temporary SFTP for them to upload contacts and any required legal forms: sftp://files.redwood-inference.com/acmehealth-poc — I'll provision read-only creds and DM them.

lisa: For staging creds we can create tenant `POC-Isolated-AH` with 30d expiry and limited egress. Ops to spin it up by EOD if legal clears the attestation flow.

devon: I'll draft a concise pen-test letter (one page) with scope, limitations, and signature block for the vendor + our legal redlines. ETA: tomorrow AM.

marie: Next steps: marie to collect customer signatory + confirm who signs the pen‑test request; devon to draft letter and send to legal for redlines; lisa to add pricing line to AE deck and provision tenant once legal OKs; sam to confirm VPC isolation feasibility with infra. :white_check_mark:

marie: FYI customer procurement also asked whether the pen-test letter can reference 'no high severity findings during last 12 months' — devon/legal, is that acceptable?

devon: We can include statement if vendor report supports it, otherwise keep neutral language: "no unresolved critical/high findings as of [date]."

lisa: Noted. I'll prep the quick FAQ for procurement (pricing timeline, POC duration, evidence delivery ETA) and drop in the dataroom.

marie: Thanks team — will update thread after I get the customer signer info.
